from build123d import *

outer_length = 80.0
outer_width = 50.0
outer_height = 30.0
wall_thickness = 2.0
opening_width = 40.0
opening_height = 15.0
rib_width = 4.0
rib_depth = 4.0
rib_height = 2.0
rib_spacing = 15.0

solid_body = Pos(0, 0, outer_height/2) * Box(outer_length, outer_width, outer_height)
top_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
solid_body = offset(solid_body, amount=-wall_thickness, openings=[top_face])

opening_cut = Pos(0, 0, opening_height/2) * Box(opening_width, outer_width, opening_height)

    x = (i - (num_ribs-1)/2) * rib_spacing
    rib = Pos(x, 0, outer_height + rib_height/2) * Box(rib_width, rib_depth, rib_height)
    solid_body = solid_body + rib

part = solid_body
part.name = "hollow_box_with_ribs"
export_step(part, "output.step")
